JiwaDocument.Name: Journal Set CSV Import
JiwaDocument.Description:
This plugin adds a menu option to the Journal Sets form to "Import From CSV". Imported journal will have it's type set to "Pending". The CSV columns will be:

AccountNo, Description, Date, Reference, Debit, Credit, BAS Code, Remark

Column headers will be included. A sample CSV file is attached to the documents tab of this plugin. BAS Codes are numeric - refer to the attached "BAS Codes.txt" document.
JiwaDocument.Author: Jiwa Financials
